test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If each vowel in the word SHOWING is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English alphabetical order, then how many letters in the original word will also appear in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9798068ad180ccbfb861ff2350399c3820019ec6dd87d8c522f977ff169c226a.png] 

**Given:**

Word: SHOWING

Vowels: O, I

Consonants: S, H, W, N, G

**Logic:**

Vowel change: Preceding letter in alphabet

Consonant change: Following letter in alphabet

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee9770846c68382a21e10eb2f9e1cb6ddc7d82b638e2a2ee91ee50dd3bcafdc2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0657ea20427c46a60b54f433dc6d753c81432e6a72afee2dc9cc09c0d3b1ba8a.png] 

Common letters: **I, H, N, O**

Count: 4

**∴ 4 letters in the original word also appear in the group of letters thus formed.**

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
